svg.title: ESHANA: from celestial positions to connected meaning
svg.desc: A turning zodiac wheel with the 27 nakshatras and the nine grahas moving on their orbits, beside the ESHANA name and what it computes.

g.text: From celestial positions to connected meaning.
A Rust engine for positions, civil time and the traditions built on them:
Jyotiṣa, Western, Human Design and numerology, auditable to the arc-second.

svg.text: Calculated · Derived by a named system · Interpretation never invented
